_doc: Mage traditions & magic-using partial classes for chargen.py. One record per tradition. 'kind' = spells|spellpoints|arts. 'full_or_partial' = which class chassis may take it (full=Mage only; partial=partial-mage slot only; both=either). 'effort_skill' = the skill whose level feeds Effort (or 'order' for the Vowed, who pick their order's skill). 'effort_attrs' = the attribute pair whose better mod is added, or 'best' for the best of all six. 'spell_lists' = spells.json 'type' values this tradition draws spells from. 'free_arts'/'art_list' = spells.json art 'type' values (arts encoded) OR [] with an arts_pointer when not yet encoded. 'chosen_arts_L1' = arts the player picks at L1 beyond free_arts. 'known_spells_full'/'known_spells_partial' = starting prepared/known spell count by chassis.

High Mage.notes: Orthodox wizard; +2 new High Magic spells each level. No casting in armor without Armored Magic.

Elementalist.notes: Earth/fire/wind/water specialist; only this class learns Elementalist New Magic. Free arts: Elemental Resilience + Elemental Sparks + 1 chosen.

Necromancer.notes: Death/undeath; widely outlawed and feared (a social hazard, not a stat). 1 chosen art at L1.

Adunic Invoker.notes: Spell-point caster (repeats minor spells, no top-end arts). Spell points = 1 + Int mod (scaling); prepare 2 + Int (full) / 1 + Int (partial). Cannot mix with any other spellcasting partial. Gains a tradition's arts only via the Traditional Education focus.

Healer.notes: Works in armor. Heal 2d6+Heal as Main Action (+1 Strain). Limb-restore/revive need L8+. Free: Healing Touch + 1 chosen.

Vowed.notes: Monastic; works in armor (but Unarmored Defense wants none). Effort uses the order's chosen skill + best attribute mod (min 1). Free: Martial Style + Unarmed Might + Unarmored Defense + 1 chosen.

Darian Skinshifter.notes: Gyre; works in armor. Masters 1 alt form/level; <=3 arts per form. Free: Change Form + 1 chosen. Arts not yet encoded in spells.json - see 11-Arts-of-the-Gyre.md.

Kistian Duelist.notes: Gyre; no arts in medium/heavy armor or with a large shield. Pw/Duelist uses 1d6 HD (Flaw of Fragility). Free: Favored Weapon + 1 chosen. Arts not yet encoded - see 11-Arts-of-the-Gyre.md.

Llaigisan Beastmaster.notes: Gyre; works in armor. One animal companion HD <= level+1; arts buff the bond. Free: Bind Companion + 1 chosen. Arts not yet encoded - see 11-Arts-of-the-Gyre.md.

Sarulite Blood Priest.notes: Gyre fighting-cleric; miracles need no gestures or free hand, only a prayer; works in armor. Picks 2 miracles at L1. Arts not yet encoded - see 11-Arts-of-the-Gyre.md.

Vothite Thought Noble.notes: Gyre psychic; works in armor; gains a new art every level L1-10. Free: Open Mind + 1 chosen. Arts not yet encoded - see 11-Arts-of-the-Gyre.md.

Accursed.notes: Atlas partial Mage. Gain Magic-0. Effort = Magic + better Int/Cha (min 1). Accursed arts work in/out of armor. Take Accursed Blade OR Accursed Bolt plus one more chosen at L1. Arts in Atlas ch04.

Bard.notes: Atlas partial Expert. Gain Perform-0. Effort = Perform + Cha mod (min 1). Bard arts are not magical and work in armor. Free: A Thousand Tongues + 1 chosen. Arts in Atlas ch04.

Mageslayer.notes: Atlas partial Warrior. Gain Magic-0. Effort = Magic + better Int/Con (min 1). Arts work in/out of armor, no free hands or incantations. Fixed progression: Antimage + Magebane at L1. No Mage class may pair with it. Arts in Atlas ch04.

Wise.notes: Atlas partial Expert for low/no-magic games. Gain a bonus skill-0 fitting the concept (Pray/Know/Magic/Survive). The Wise DO NOT use Effort; arts are constant or used a set number of times/day. Pick a starting General/Divination art + Curses & Blessings per concept. Arts in Atlas ch04.
